authorization.rule: Shared or frozen contract changes are allowed only if purely ADDITIVE (new optional fields or functions, no changed signature or behavior for existing callers). Revert any NON-additive change to C2- or S0-owned files. If the feature truly needs one, stop with OPEN naming the exact hunk.

additiveChanges: New calendar-management.ts helper, manifest rows, optional blockSelector and opt-in host/resolver/listing functions alongside all frozen contracts
New operation-extension.ts optional support keyed by opted-in row and exact frozen request identity; legacy requests have no extension
HeldRequest.freeze implementation invokes draft binding only for an opted-in row; no existing method signature changes
Client held transport supports a qualified extension endpoint only on that exact opted-in frozen request; default resolver behavior is unchanged
Host adds review references, pre-send revalidation and deletion confirmation only through optional extension callbacks
New loadWriteRecoveryForSpec helper validates opt-in recovery declarations; original loadWriteRecovery behavior is preserved
Returned-identity preparation consults an optional per-request schema without replacing frozen identity policies
recovery: Calendar recovery with no qualified bounded selector retains no read target and settles unknown with zero lookup reads and zero resends. Calendar creation never scans the location calendar collection.
verification: Base and final unchanged calendar tests compared by exact names; new opt-in tests, typecheck, isolated fixture and source mutants are recorded in afix3-hlf4/DONE.
